page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.sn2ne family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, equipped with a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any bundled local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 decompression single-threaded benchmarks, which all fall into the bottom 25 percent, while single-threaded gzip compression is poor. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance. Multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression all rank in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with Passmark memory and database operations, also consistently register in the average tier.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers moderate cost efficiency for workloads that can parallelize tasks across its 32 dedicated cores rather than relying on high single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale Redis deployments, all of which achieved average tier benchmark results. It is also capable of handling small to medium LLM inference tasks, though it is not suitable for larger models due to the absence of GPU acceleration and local storage.
